_readme: PRACTICE LABELS for scoring the agent. The agent must never read this file during a run. Made-up scenarios.

p01.explanation: ack timeout drops to 5s but the consumer takes ~3-8s per message, so many messages are redelivered while still being processed; the consumer has no idempotency key and the ledger has no unique key on the message, so cards are charged twice.

p02.explanation: Same redeliveries as p01, but the consumer de-duplicates on message_id with a unique key, so no refund is applied twice.

p03.explanation: 30 replicas x 20 pooled connections = 600, above the database's max_connections of 500, so 100 connections are refused.

p04.explanation: 24 replicas x 20 = 480, just under max_connections=500. Close, but no failure under test.

p05.explanation: The producer switches to ISO-8601 with T and Z, but the consumer still parses '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', so every event fails to parse.

p06.explanation: During the daily brownout 20% of 100 rps fail; 5 immediate retries with no backoff push peak load to ~200 rps against a 120 rps gateway limit.

p07.explanation: DEBUG writes 6 x 400 = 2400 MB/h; rotation runs every 6h (14,400 MB) but only 9,000 MB is free, so the disk fills after ~3.75h.

p08.explanation: Timeout drops to 2000 ms; the tax API's p99 is 1500 ms and its 30-day max is 1750 ms, so nothing times out under test.

p09.explanation: Runs every 15 minutes but each run takes ~22 minutes and there is no lock; runs overlap and both select the same not-yet-exported invoices, so invoices are exported twice.

p10.explanation: Adds a nullable column with a concurrent index; both readers use explicit column lists, so nothing breaks.
